description: This file defines components and functions related to selecting and inserting table blocks within a rich text editor. It provides options for table sizes based on user queries and interacts with the Lexical editor via commands.

methods.name: GetTableBlockOption
methods.description: Creates a new BlockPickerOption for a table block, setting its name, icon, keywords, and select callback.

methods.name: GetDynamicTableBlocks
methods.description: Generates table block options based on user query, supporting specific table sizes or ranges, and dispatching commands to insert tables into the editor.
